MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
The supplied regime is NEUTRAL, with normal volatility at 29.1% but weak participation: 0/8 sectors positive over 1W. The narrow breadth makes the backdrop fragile despite volatility remaining below the high-volatility threshold.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Transportation leads relatively, though still BELOW TREND: 1W -3.40% | 1M -11.37%. Holding & Investment follows at 1W -3.78% | 1M -11.11%, also BELOW TREND; SAHOL (1W: +2.58% | 1M: -3.90%) is in RECOVERY.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology & Telecom is weakest at 1W -13.42% | 1M -22.06%, BELOW TREND, followed by Energy & Chemicals at 1W -11.22% | 1M -20.49%, BELOW TREND. Construction & REIT is also weak at 1W -10.45% | 1M -17.38%, BELOW TREND.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
The best relative performers remain mostly negative: SAHOL (1W: +2.58% | 1M: -3.90%) is in RECOVERY; SOKM (1W: -1.03% | 1M: -1.96%) is BELOW TREND; TAVHL (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -4.98%) is BELOW TREND. PGSUS (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -15.90%) and YKBNK (1W: -2.70% | 1M: -4.23%) are both BELOW TREND.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
The sharpest weekly declines were KONTR (1W: -26.20% | 1M: -45.67%), TKFEN (1W: -20.16% | 1M: -35.98%), VESTL (1W: -17.90% | 1M: -36.58%), TRMET (1W: -16.97% | 1M: -25.63%), and GUBRF (1W: -15.97% | 1M: -25.22%). All five are BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
SAHOL (1W: +2.58% | 1M: -3.90%) is the only stock with positive 1W momentum and is in RECOVERY. The least weak weekly moves were SOKM (1W: -1.03% | 1M: -1.96%), TAVHL (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -4.98%), PGSUS (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -15.90%), and YKBNK (1W: -2.70% | 1M: -4.23%); all are BELOW TREND.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Banking remains BELOW TREND, with the sector down 1W -5.47% | 1M -9.34%. YKBNK (1W: -2.70% | 1M: -4.23%) and GARAN (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -3.96%) show relative resilience, while AKBNK (1W: -5.00% | 1M: -11.45%) and ISCTR (1W: -5.19% | 1M: -8.94%) remain weak; all four are BELOW TREND.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Heavy Industry is BELOW TREND, down 1W -8.10% | 1M -17.94%. EREGL (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -8.93%), FROTO (1W: -5.94% | 1M: -15.22%), TOASO (1W: -9.18% | 1M: -19.82%), and ASELS (1W: -3.63% | 1M: -11.34%) are all BELOW TREND, with ASELS the relative weekly outperformer.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
Energy & Chemicals is the second-weakest sector, down 1W -11.22% | 1M -20.49%, BELOW TREND. TUPRS (1W: -8.39% | 1M: -12.76%), PETKM (1W: -10.03% | 1M: -20.43%), and HEKTS (1W: -12.02% | 1M: -19.38%) are BELOW TREND; avoid assuming a reversal without breadth improvement.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Stay defensive, keep gross exposure measured, and prioritize liquidity while breadth is 0/8 and every sector is negative on the week. Avoid broad sector additions; require improving participation and price stabilization before increasing cyclical risk.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
Monitor SAHOL (1W: +2.58% | 1M: -3.90%), the sole RECOVERY setup, for follow-through. Track YKBNK (1W: -2.70% | 1M: -4.23%), TAVHL (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -4.98%), and PGSUS (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -15.90%) for relative resilience; each remains BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Watch Transportation (1W: -3.40% | 1M: -11.37%) and Holding & Investment (1W: -3.78% | 1M: -11.11%) for stabilization, though both remain BELOW TREND. Energy & Chemicals (1W: -11.22% | 1M: -20.49%) is the key downside-risk gauge.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
No XU100 spot levels or support/resistance data were provided, so specific index levels cannot be stated. Key triggers are a recovery in sector breadth from 0/8, volatility moving below 25%, and confirmation that weekly declines are easing.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime conditions mask very weak breadth: volatility is normal at 29.1%, but no sector posted a positive 1W return. SAHOL is the lone RECOVERY setup; otherwise, maintain a defensive stance and watch for breadth stabilization before adding risk.
